fields.event_id: string   - readable pointer back to the raw CSV row
fields.session_id: string   - namespaced, or None when the source is empty
fields.category_code: string   - readable name, or __UNK__ when missing
fields.brand: string   - brand name, or __UNK__ when missing
fields.price: float    - raw price, no bucketing yet
fields.source_row_number: int      - original 1-based row number in the CSV

smoke_sample.parquet.description: every event of a deterministic slice of real users
smoke_sample.parquet.intended_use: interface and integration testing, not a training cohort
